title: visionMCP configuration
description: Configuration for the visionMCP server. Precedence: overrides > VISIONMCP_* env vars > this file > built-in defaults.

api_key.description: API key for openai/anthropic. Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. Ignored for ollama.

api_url.description: API base URL. Defaults per provider (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for ollama).

model.description: Vision model name. Defaults per provider.

default_prompt.description: System prompt sent with every request.

image_detail.description: Image resolution sent to OpenAI/Ollama-compatible providers.

max_image_mb.description: Payload ceiling in MB; larger images are downscaled and re-encoded as JPEG.

max_image_dimension.description: Longest edge in pixels after automatic resizing.

jpeg_quality.description: JPEG quality used when re-encoding oversized images.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for provider API calls and image URL downloads.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the vision model may generate per call.

server_name.description: Name advertised by the MCP server.

transport.description: MCP transport. stdio for local MCP clients; http for remote hosting.
